summary: Chanson International Holding, a U.S.-listed (Nasdaq) Chinese bakery and food manufacturer headquartered in Urumqi, filed a routine Form 6-K reporting interim financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes XBRL-tagged financial data and mentions a securities purchase agreement dated August 14, 2026 related to Class A common stock in a subsequent event. There is no special-situations event: no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, spin-off, or forced management change. This is an ordinary periodic financial report and does not warrant special-situations classification.
